Use a simple clear pose rather than hiding anatomy behind effects. Keep open spaces between limbs and both wings readable. Whole body, every foot, wing and tail tip inside central 80% with breathing room. Readable at 170px. One square 1:1 illustration. No text, letters, numbers, watermark, frame, border or UI. Do not include text, letters, numbers, watermark, signature or logo. Avoid extra limbs, extra eyes or pupils, fused hands or paws, disconnected joints, deformed anatomy, blurry or cropped subjects. Do not invent a fox-like torso, fur, animal paws or tail. Walking plants may have two leaf/branch arms and two root feet, each attached to a single stem/trunk. Keep one coherent face.
review: Visually reviewed: One rounded seed body, two intact eyes, no animal limbs. Retro ink and parchment match reference. Approved.
